analyst.summary: KNR Constructions is going through a genuine, severe order-execution slowdown - revenue fell about 43% in the latest year and returns on capital have dropped from the mid-20s to about 10% - while debt has nearly doubled and working capital has deteriorated sharply. The statistically low 8x P/E does not look like a bargain here; it looks like the market correctly pricing a real slowdown in a business whose new order intake has not kept pace with completing projects. We recommend keeping this a Sell.
